dedupe_keys.name: engineering with nature project mapper promap

description: ProMap is an interactive map viewer of projects that fit the Engineering With Nature approach of aligning natural and engineering processes to deliver economic, environmental and social benefits. It brings together projects from multiple organisations worldwide, viewable by project category (beaches and dunes, wetlands, islands and others) or by intended benefit (bird habitat, shore protection, recreation and others), with project information and resources for each selected project, and it accepts new project submissions. It sits in the EWN tools list alongside the EWN Compass implementation toolbox for natural and nature-based features, the Watershed Modeling System, the GSSHA hydrologic model and a dam removal cost estimator. Access is free and public; no licence is stated. Caveats: entries are curated case summaries, not engineering data, and coverage leans towards US Army Corps projects. It helps identify precedents for natural and nature-based coastal and river flood defences in climate adaptation and resilience planning; related records are the NetworkNature NbS databases and the Oppla repository.
